h_u = W · CONCAT( h_u , agg ) + b
W, b are per-edge-type weights (θ_t). No shared weights across types.
ℒ = BCE(score_pos, 1) + BCE(score_neg, 0) · no labels used
session-level representation for all downstream tasks
no label leakage — labels used only in evaluation
Self-supervised: no process labels used in graph construction, GNN training, embedding, or retrieval. Labels appear only in final evaluation (§⑤ metrics and controls).
